subject: Next steps: SIG initiation & SOC 2 evidence mapping for Medivar
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@medivar.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@medivar.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-14T17:12:00-04:00
Subject: Next steps: SIG initiation & SOC 2 evidence mapping for Medivar

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on scope:  

- Goal: get you a completed SIG (or CAIQ) prefill and an evidence map so your security team can review.
- Current posture we understood on the call: SOC 2 in progress (Type II expected Q4), we heard HIPAA applicability for patient PII and EU residency is not required.

Can you confirm two quick things so we route the right questionnaire and owners?
1) Is SOC 2 Type II the only compliance doc you'll accept for production access, or do you need anything else (e.g., HITRUST attestation)?
2) Who should be the main security/technical contact on your side for evidence collection (name + email)?

If that lines up, we can send a prefilled SIG starter and a spreadsheet with the initial answers you can review, plus proposed timings for evidence delivery. I’ve looped Ben and Jordan from our security intake and CS teams to help with the evidence mapping.

Attachments I’ll send in the next thread: SIG-Starter-20280614.pdf and a prefill workbook to speed things up.

Thanks — small asks so we can move to the kickoff: confirm SOC 2 acceptance and the security contact.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales 
Redwood Inference
[Attachment planned: SIG-Starter-20280614.pdf]

From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@medivar.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@medivar.com>, legal@medivar.com
Date: 2028-06-15T09:46:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: SIG initiation & SOC 2 evidence mapping for Medivar

Naomi — thanks for the recap and for the clear asks. A few clarifications from our side before you send anything over:  

- SOC 2: we will accept SOC 2 Type II for the controls listed in section 3 of our intake; however, since we process PHI, our legal team wants confirmation that you can sign a BAA and that your SOC 2 scope includes encryption-at-rest controls.
- HITRUST: not required for us at this time.
- Data residency: we are US-only for now, but we will need the ability to route EU traffic separately in future — not urgent today.
- Security contact: please work with Tom Reyes (tom.reyes@medivar.com) for technical evidence and cc legal@medivar.com for policy/contract items.

Also: what level of detail do you need in the prefill? We usually push back if it asks for system-level diagrams.

Samantha Li
Head of IT Security
Medivar

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks for the quick replies and helpful clarifications. Re BAA: Naomi looped me in — we can sign a standard BAA; I’ve added Jordan from Legal Ops to help coordinate that separately.

Attached are two items to kick things off:  
- SIG-Starter-20280614.pdf (short explanation of our SIG approach and the sections we typically prefill)
- Medivar_SIG_Prefill_Answers.xlsx (our suggested answers based on your discovery call; please mark any items you prefer to edit)

High-level notes:
- We’ve prefilled only control-level responses (we intentionally avoid attaching internal architecture diagrams in the prefill). If you need diagrams, we can provide redacted/network-level diagrams under an NDA or via a secure share.
- For SOC 2 encryption controls: we have encryption at-rest and in-transit; the prefill points to section 6.2 in our SOC 2 report and lists our KMS provider. We can provide the SOC 2 readiness artifacts now and the full Type II once issued (Q4).

Proposed timeline: 
1) You review the prefill and flag redlines — 3 business days
2) Evidence handoff for mandatory controls — 7 business days after agreement on the prefill
3) BAA execution parallel with 1) (Ben/Jordan to own)

Attachments: [Attachment: Medivar_SIG_Prefill_Answers.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)], [Attachment: SIG-Starter-20280614.pdf (PDF, 340KB)]

Can we schedule a 30-min evidence-handoff call next week? I’m available Tue/Wed afternoon ET.

Best,
Ben Carter
Security Intake Lead
Redwood Inference
